notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Our pull_request workflow feels slower than last month. Capture a baseline and propose one concrete speedup.
evals.expected_output: The skill selects one workflow, event class, and job set, captures baseline GitHub Actions runs with the full-wait rule, then presents one concrete edit plan with affected files, expected benefit, risks, and verification before any change.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Time how long `just build` takes on my machine and make it faster.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to measure local command timing itself and redirects the request to /build-optimize, keeping its own scope to GitHub Actions wait time.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Skip the baseline, just purge the Actions cache and edit the workflow now to speed things up.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to purge the cache or edit the workflow without a captured baseline and explicit authorization, and instead presents the measurement plan first.
